Italian oasis in Hue
Oct 2026 • Friends
The restaurant is like an oasis. To have an authentic Italian restaurant in amongst the local restaurants was very welcome. We've been eating local food for over a week now and this was a nice change. 
The food was wonderful and the staff were very friendly and spoke English very well. 
I would definitely recommend this restaurant.
Written October 7, 2026

5 contributions

A great place to go.
Oct 2026 • Family
Great place for yummy food inspired by Italy. 
Our waiter Mr Viet was really attentive and kind. We learnt some new Vietnamese words. The homemade fettuccine was delicious. The gnocchi was very very good. My son loved the spaghetti bolognaise so much he almost licked the bowl. We had an interesting wine from Chilli and there were some other nice wines to choose from. All in all, a great experience because we had been missing food from Australia and it hit the spot. Also had some nice Vietnamese food options too.
